basic_info.description: Rarely available townhome-style residence on the northern slope of Potrero, offering a spacious layout across two levels that adapts gracefully to every stage of life. The lower level features open living, kitchen and dining, one bedroom, half-bath, and in-unit W/D. A private street entry on this floor creates a sense of ease and connection to the neighborhood. Upstairs is bathed in light from west-facing windows, and offers two bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite, each with huge walk-in closets, plus two baths. Two garage parking spaces are included, with EV charging. Built in 2007, The Potrero is a contemporary, secure community with a well-equipped fitness center (including a Pilates reformer), elevator, lush courtyards, and a rooftop deck ideal for dining al fresco while taking in sweeping Bay views and summer fireworks. The neighborhood is envied as one of the warmest and sunniest in the entire city (no wonder it's attracting AI companies), and life here is ultra convenient - Whole Foods is downstairs, and neighborhood favorites like Le March Cezanne, Ruby Wine, and Alimentari Aurora are just steps away. With Plow, Chez Maman, Michelin star dining, nearby parks and playgrounds, and easy access around the city and beyond, this is Potrero Hill living at its best.
